g.text: DevEBox STM32H750VBT6 Universal Flight & Rover Controller (Dual-Magnetometer Revision)
Complete Circuit & Schematic Interconnect • PX4 Autopilot / NuttX Architecture • DUAL COMPASS (Mast Mag 1 on I2C1 + Frame Mag 2 on I2C2) • 8 Motor Outputs • Isolated Power Domains
3V3 GND PB15 PB13 PB12 PB14 PB1 PB0
SPARE SPI2 FOR OPTICAL FLOW / SPI LIDAR
BEC 2: 5V 1A for GPS, ESP32, and ELRS Receiver

Native USB Virtual COM Port • DFU Firmware Upload (Bench Only)
